points.description: States that all dimensions except the first must be specified (e.g. for a 2-D array, the number of columns must be given; for an n-D array, the sizes of dimensions 2 to n).
points.partial_credit: 1.5 marks if the answer says only that the dimensions other than one must be given, or gives a correct example without stating the general rule.

points.description: Identifies the first dimension as the one that may be omitted / left unspecified (e.g. arr[][5]).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if the first dimension is mentioned as optional but the rest are not clearly stated as required.
